answer.summary: Only one test failed: the graph explorer no-remount test. Its mount spy was never called (expected 1, got 0) right after findByTestId('expand') resolved, which looks like a render-timing race rather than a regression. The change touched only translation JSON files, and the many MissingTranslationError lines are fallback warnings spread across unrelated tests, so they don't point to this failure. Low-confidence retry; the log can't fully rule out a link to the en.json edits.
